PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Corrects the flow: verify signature, idempotently log the event, dispatch to a task, acknowledge 200 within the provider timeout
- Points at the dispatcher task pattern: map event types to handlers, skip processed events, retry on handler failure

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
